summary: validate-modules codes for missing RETURN docs and suboption docs, wrong version_added, wildcard module_utils imports, multiple utils per requires, defaults on required options, and missing no_log on secret-looking options.
questions: How do I fix the no-log-needed error?
Can a required option have a default?

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (return, version, no_log)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `missing-return` / `missing-return-legacy`: no RETURN docs
- `missing-suboption-docs`: spec has suboptions the docs lack
- `module-incorrect-version-added` / `module-invalid-version-added`
- `module-utils-specific-import`: import specific names, not `*`
- `multiple-utils-per-requires` / `multiple-csharp-utils-per-requires`: one per statement
- `no-default-for-required-parameter`: required options can't have a default
- `no-log-needed`: option looks secret; set `no_log=True`, or `no_log=False` explicitly for a false positive
